summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1 and verified the result persisted through a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created the locked, non-login system account inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers.
Set all existing objects to inventorysvc:inventory-readers.
Set directories to 0750 and regular files to 0640.
Verified owner access, group read-only access, and denial for unrelated users.
Restarted node1 safely and verified complete recovery.

evidence.summary: Before, after, and post-restart SHA-256 hashes match; the tree remains two directories, two files, and 72 file bytes.

evidence.requirement: Owned by inventorysvc and readable by inventory-readers
evidence.summary: All objects are inventorysvc:inventory-readers; directories are 0750, files are 0640, and a group-only identity successfully read both files but could not write them.
Other permission bits and additional ACL grants are absent; an unrelated user received Permission denied.

Healthy baseline captured with boot ID 8ac0a119-4645-4ec4-a262-37892ad89da1; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed to 0483288a-4876-4fb6-9b02-dc2d453f88f5; system, filesystem, identities, permissions, hashes, and effective access all recovered.
